phone_projection_menu.description: Settings > Phone Projection: wireless features -> wireless page; else US/Canada (REGION 1/4) with Device Connections -> it; else the other page
phone_projection_menu.expression:
const-string v0, "com\.hkmc\.software\.connectivity\.carplay_wireless"
invoke-static \{v0\}, Lcom/hkmc/Feature;->hasFeature\(Ljava/lang/String;\)Z
move-result v0
if-nez v0, (?P<l1>:cond_\w+)
const-string v0, "com\.hkmc\.software\.connectivity\.androidauto_wireless"
invoke-static \{v0\}, Lcom/hkmc/Feature;->hasFeature\(Ljava/lang/String;\)Z
move-result v0
if-eqz v0, (?P<l2>:cond_\w+)
(?P=l1)
invoke-virtual \{p0\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/BluetoothSettings;->getApplicationContext\(\)Landroid/content/Context;
move-result-object v0
invoke-static \{v0\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/(?P<helper>\w+);->(?P<wireless>\w+)\(Landroid/content/Context;\)V
goto/16 :goto_\w+
(?P=l2)
sget v0, Lcom/hkmc/BuildInfo;->REGION:I
if-eq v0, v2, (?P<l3>:cond_\w+)
sget v0, Lcom/hkmc/BuildInfo;->REGION:I
const/4 v1, 0x4
if-ne v0, v1, (?P<l4>:cond_\w+)
(?P=l3)
invoke-static \{\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/(?P=helper);->(?P<available>\w+)\(\)Z
move-result v0
if-eqz v0, (?P=l4)
invoke-virtual \{p0\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/BluetoothSettings;->getApplicationContext\(\)Landroid/content/Context;
move-result-object v0
invoke-static \{v0, v2\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/(?P=helper);->(?P<dc>\w+)\(Landroid/content/Context;I\)V
goto/16 :goto_\w+
(?P=l4)
invoke-virtual \{p0\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/BluetoothSettings;->getApplicationContext\(\)Landroid/content/Context;
move-result-object v0
invoke-static \{v0\}, Lcom/android/settings2/bluetooth/(?P=helper);->(?P<other>\w+)\(Landroid/content/Context;\)V

btsettings.pp_bt.about: BtSettings' PhoneProjection client (obfuscated name, found by the delete-request log literal): the Bluetooth delete and disconnect calls

btsettings.pp_bt.request_delete.about: deletes a phone's PhoneProjection record by Bluetooth address (true: deleted); disconnects the phone first when it is the connected CarPlay or Android Auto device

btsettings.pp_bt.send_disconnect.about: sends the PhoneProjection disconnect for the connected phone's Bluetooth address (no address: logs only)

btsettings.projection_helper.about: BtSettings' static helper that opens the Phone Projection pages

btsettings.projection_helper.open_wirele.about: opens the wireless projection page (its only caller is the Phone Projection menu)
